# Inline Links Test

Testing angle bracket inline links.

## URL Links

Visit <https://www.example.com> for more info.

HTTP link: <http://example.org>

## Email Links

Explicit mailto: <mailto:support@example.com>

Bare emails like <user@example.com> are valid Markdown but not validated as references.

## Mixed Content

Normal link: [text](file.md)

Inline link: <https://github.com>

Another normal: [other](other.md)
